_meta.name: Social Network Control-Flow Property Verification Certificate

verifications.description: StorePost channel message cannot be dispatched before all 4 caller parallel fan-out dispatches (media, text, unique-id, user) have fired.
verifications.formula: EF(ch__StorePost > 0 AND (compose_post_service__p_5 > 0 OR compose_post_service__p_7 > 0 OR compose_post_service__p_9 > 0 OR compose_post_service__p_11 > 0))
verifications.name: Fork-Join Dispatch Barrier: All Fan-Out Requests Before StorePost

verifications.description: Timeline fan-out writes (WriteHomeTimeline and WriteUserTimeline) cannot be dispatched prior to StorePost dispatch.
verifications.formula: EF((ch__WriteHomeTimeline > 0 OR ch__WriteUserTimeline > 0) AND compose_post_service__p_13 = 0 AND compose_post_service__p_14 = 0 AND compose_post_service__sink = 0)
verifications.name: Service Sequencing: StorePost Dispatch Precedes Timeline Writes

verifications.description: Downstream child RPC channels (ComposeUrls and ComposeUserMentions) cannot hold tokens while root workflow remains at initial source marking.
verifications.name: Causal Invocations: Downstream RPCs Require Prior Workflow Initiation

verifications.description: The root compose-post-service source place and sink place cannot be concurrently marked.
verifications.name: Mutual Exclusion: Workflow Source and Sink Conflict Freedom

verifications.description: When all participating service sink places are marked, all 9 interface channels must hold zero residual tokens.
verifications.formula: EF(compose_post_service__sink > 0 AND home_timeline_service__sink > 0 AND media_service__sink > 0 AND post_storage_service__sink > 0 AND text_service__sink > 0 AND unique_id_service__sink > 0 AND url_shorten_service__sink > 0 AND user_mention_service__sink > 0 AND user_service__sink > 0 AND user_timeline_service__sink > 0 AND (ch__ComposeCreatorWithUserId > 0 OR ch__ComposeMedia > 0 OR ch__ComposeText > 0 OR ch__ComposeUniqueId > 0 OR ch__ComposeUrls > 0 OR ch__ComposeUserMentions > 0 OR ch__StorePost > 0 OR ch__WriteHomeTimeline > 0 OR ch__WriteUserTimeline > 0))
verifications.name: Clean Channel Drainage: Residual Message Freedom Upon Termination

verifications.description: No interface channel place can hold more than 1 token in any reachable marking.
verifications.formula: EF(ch__ComposeCreatorWithUserId > 1 OR ch__ComposeMedia > 1 OR ch__ComposeText > 1 OR ch__ComposeUniqueId > 1 OR ch__ComposeUrls > 1 OR ch__ComposeUserMentions > 1 OR ch__StorePost > 1 OR ch__WriteHomeTimeline > 1 OR ch__WriteUserTimeline > 1)
verifications.name: Channel 1-Boundedness: 1-Safety Invariant Across All Communication Channels

verifications.description: No reachable intermediate state can become trapped in a premature deadlock before global completion.
verifications.formula: EF(DEADLOCK AND NOT (compose_post_service__sink > 0 AND home_timeline_service__sink > 0 AND media_service__sink > 0 AND post_storage_service__sink > 0 AND text_service__sink > 0 AND unique_id_service__sink > 0 AND url_shorten_service__sink > 0 AND user_mention_service__sink > 0 AND user_service__sink > 0 AND user_timeline_service__sink > 0))
verifications.name: Quasi-Liveness: Premature Deadlock Freedom

counterexample.explanation: Trace of 6 step(s) reached a state satisfying target condition: ch__StorePost > 0 AND (media_service__sink = 0 OR text_service__sink = 0 OR unique_id_service__sink = 0 OR user_service__sink = 0)

verifications.description: Validates reachability of state where StorePost channel is active while asynchronous child services are executing in parallel.
verifications.formula: EF(ch__StorePost > 0 AND (media_service__sink = 0 OR text_service__sink = 0 OR unique_id_service__sink = 0 OR user_service__sink = 0))
verifications.name: Asynchronous Concurrency: Callee Interleaving Witness Reachability
